desc: The Hypa-Lite Bull Stalker Rifle Sling with Swivels is a sling designed with elk hunting in mind. The sling begins with ultra-durable and lightweight hypalon construction with molded, low-density foam and a non-slip backing. The front of the sling features Mossy Oak Mountain Country camo and blaze orange accents in quiet fabric, plus a stretch mesh pockets for your windicator and diaphragm calls, plus three spare cartridge loops. Includes D-rings to attach accessories, an adjustable ladder lock buckle and swivels tested up to 500 pounds.
